theorems.name: Submission.iwl_integer_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 2 ≤ P → SlicingTheorem → LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).boundary = 0) → (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsRectifiableCurrent T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
